Can you please provide a script example similar to my situation?

I appreciate comments and help.

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] distance with R
parts:
Joaquin


There are a number of example R analyses at the distancesampling.org website.  If you read through the example analysis of ducknests (http://distancesampling.org/R/vignettes/ducknests.html), that will get you started, although the ducknest data does not have clusters.  Also be advised that 5 transects is a small number to accurately estimate the variability in numbers of animals between transects; this is an important component in measuring the uncertainty in your abundance estimates.

Simple detection function analysis of duck nests
distancesampling.org
Simple detection function analysis of duck nests Eric Rexstad Tuesday 10 June, 2014
